Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Auburndale for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 3 (Lights in the Park at the Historic Depot) through December 12, with the Havendale Christmas Parade (December 4), Breakfast with Santa at Lake Ariana Civic Center (December 5) and Light Up Lake Alfred (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Auburndale
